entries.96be8f2577f91237: This business manufactures and sells industrial sewing machines used in garment production at sewing factories, specifically the type called "chain-stitch sewing machines," which are mainly used for sewing knitwear and other garments. The company, Mima Seiki Co., Ltd., and six overseas manufacturing and sales subsidiaries carry out this business, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,830 million, making it the group's largest business.
